title: Senior IRGC official Mohsen Rezaei DECLARES 'NO-GO ZONE AREA' around HORMUZ
text:
Senior IRGC official Mohsen Rezaei DECLARES 'NO-GO ZONE AREA' around HORMUZ"

"Says area will start at US Navy's blockade line & EXTEND to the Strait"

"Zone will also extend into the Persian Gulf — ships crossing it to be IDENTIFIED & SANCTIONED
